description: This file defines the NotRequired validation rule class within the OrangeHRM core API validation framework. It checks if a value is not required based on certain conditions, with an option to exclude empty strings from being considered empty.

classes.name: NotRequired
classes.description: A validation rule class that ensures a value is considered not required, with an option to exclude empty strings from being treated as empty.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor to initialize the rule with an option to exclude empty strings from validation.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the input based on whether it is required or not, considering the excludeEmptyString flag.
